steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You tell them to drink, but what about you? How many pints have you downed?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Pipe down, old bones. I just gotta fire up the engine in me—

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: —What's wrong, girl?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Not looking too good there. You and Zofia haven't patched things up yet?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm fine... Has Auntie been here again?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She was pacing around right by the door, but then she left just a minute ago. She's worried about you.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I say you go find her.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: They've already decided my next opponent.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If I can win, do you think my auntie... do you think everyone will understand me then?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: There, girl...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Things aren't that simple, Maria.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey! Watch it, old boy, what're you blabbering?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The reason Zofia doesn't want you in the Major's not just because she reckons you'll lose or get hurt...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The competition isn't fair. See, the moment you set foot up higher, you're up against more than just your opponents...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Think corps. Corps playing other corps. Families fighting other families.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Not even them Adeptus watchdogs'll stick their hands in. Between the Knights Association, Grand Knight and all the directors, they make a three-way power tussle messier than you might ever imagine.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Course, I wouldn't tell you to give up, Maria.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: 'Think it through, look at all the difficulties you'll face, and only then should you press on. ' When you figure that one out, go knock 'em all the hell down for us old-timers to see.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: We've got a new face—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: —You're not welcome here. Kindly leave.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Don't be so cold, my old friend, dear Tremoriron Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Your sacrifice brought a chronic heat to us all. I'm greatly respectful of your disposition within the arena.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Who the hell're you?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...The level-2 knight, Vogelweide... the former second-order knight. Or ought I be calling you Batbayar? I'm not sure if I'm pronouncing it correctly...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Ooh, no, no, let's not bring the daggers out. I'm certainly no knight, merely an assiduous civil servant...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Cool it! Vogelweide!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...If I had my bow on hand, you wouldn't dare talk to me like that.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I appear to have made a transgression. If I offended you, I deeply, profoundly apologize.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Leave that little two-faced act by the door. What are you doing here?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: ...I'm a mere working stiff. As is natural, I'm here to relay to Miss Maria Nearl some arrangements the Knights Association have made.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Miss Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... um, here...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Your next opponent has been duly decided.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: No reason to come in person for this.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: True, but I do prefer to handle things personally. It is the only way I ensure I have an exact grasp on all manner of matters that may arise in the workflow... Of course, there's a selfish element as well.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I can hardly contain my curiosity regarding the sister of the Radiant Knight Margaret Nearl. The young knight who's all the rage.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: There are many seeded players, hopefuls for the Major, who have hardly the popularity to match up to you, Miss Maria. It is a strength you bear as a competition knight, an advantage.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I hope to see you make appropriate use of this advantage. Of course, I also possess many... high-grade business contracts.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: When compared to any of those sponsors who sought you out in private, I can guarantee that these are all corporate and Knightclub affiliations beyond your imagination...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: We're long sick of your sales pitch. Maria here takes things her own way.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hear, hear! You've taken all the glory out of knighthood. It's profane!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Glory? Ah... right, glory.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: The campaign knights garrisoned the frontier fortresses at dawn, and competitors of every standing brought value regardless to Kazimierz—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Glory, where is glory? Has it vanished?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No-one can excise glory from Kazimierz. Not even if the hundreds of thousands of Kazimierz companies, big and small, were to join forces as one.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: So have knights been reduced to tools of war, eyes blinded by profit? Have knights abandoned glory themselves, forgotten their pasts?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No and no. To say that is to look down on the knights. No director would dare entertain the lie that knights have become marionettes. For what reason would the flourishing of the competition knights bring us sorrow?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: *Spit*! Who are you to talk about glory?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Kazimierz can't even remember what the past—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: —Past glory, the spirit of knighthood, ah—the great transcendental soul! The sun that beamed in history's hollows!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Do I have that right? But neither spectator nor tourist need spirit, and it's hardly necessary for us to make a show of it for them.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Slippery little... I could tear your face off right now.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Ah, let's not be so hasty. Glory, yes, what a wonderful thing, what an impeccable thing, and still it exists upon every knight family's crest—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: —But, most unfortunately, the Kazimierz people no longer need it.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It has not been abandoned, nor drowned beneath. It has always been here. The simple fact is people nowadays... do not need it.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I can hardly even say 'abandoned' is fair, my friend. When you buy an all-new intercity net-connected digital television, and you stow away your old radio into the cupboard, do you call that 'abandoned?'

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Rather, it's forgotten. Not the kind that carries a spiteful meaning. It is the pure kind of forgetting, the one that results from the progress that scientific advancement and new modes of life bring.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: How can you denounce progress itself? My friend?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Don't call me 'friend' this or 'friend' that. There's not a single friend of yours here.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Finish up fast and trot on home. Maria isn't on display here.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: No, my friend, you are wrong once again.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Of course I do not stand in front of a knight simply to demean her status. No, but every knight has the obligation to recognize her own responsibility to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Knights are no exhibits, but the most noble and lavish of the showcases, for all the world to gaze upon the beauty of Kazimierz! I dearly hope you can all understand this.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley... you think we went overboard this time? Hey, Ashley, come on. Did you pass out?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Ggh, it's so loud... shit hurts...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haha, yeah, I get you... but we have to keep up the pace. Want me to carry you?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: ...In hell!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They haven't caught up with us yet... What street are we on, even?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: There's... their breath, from the front! Turn left!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Okay—hold on tight—!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...When's the next match?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Oh, my apologies, I'd almost forgotten what I was here for.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It's three days from now, and your opponent will be the Left-hand Knight... 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: As a sidenote, Miss Maria, if you accept any of the Knightclub proposals I've put forward to you, then even supposing you have no luck in the Major—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: —I can still guarantee the legitimacy of your noble knighthood will remain secure.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I'm sure Miss 'Whislash' Zofia, and the Radiant Knight, far away wherever she is, will both be reassured.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I appreciate your kindness.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'll make Kazimierz recognize the Nearl family. I won't let all my ancestors' efforts go to waste. I WILL prove that the Nearl family deserves its knighthood!

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Well, well, you'll prove... in the competition... Tell me, will you prove?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Is cooperation with a corporation not the greatest proof a knight could have of her status? When you face your most ardent fans, tourists from all corners of Terra, the loyal clientele of Kazimierz, what is it that you so desperately want to tell them—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: —What will you prove?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I will prove...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: —Pardon?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I'm sorry, please wait a moment.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Hello? Speaking. What? No, I'm currently... Right, I understand. Please, don't worry.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Regretfully, Miss Maria, it seems I cannot wait for your answer.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: And to you, gentlemen, pardon the offense I've caused, and I hope you have a pleasant evening.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Keh. Get outta here.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Well, then. Let me bid you farewell. If you ever change your mind, contact me at any time.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Makes me want to hurl seeing that corp slime face.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Say, V... Why'd he know your...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...I'd like to know myself. Since my grandpappy passed on, been the better half of a century since I heard a soul call my old name.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: And his pronunciation was a pile of shit.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Things are getting risky. Knights Association and the corps are looking into us now. Looking into all of us.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Someone might've already started making moves.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Don't look like that, Maria. You're not alone here. We owe a hell of a lot to your old Grandpa Nearl. We're all—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Anyone here—!? Sorry, we got a casualty—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...The Flametail Knight?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Nearl...? Uh, let's make this quick—could you help us out here a bit?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Ugh... well, this sucks... I was looking forward to our arena matchup. Now I get to remember you as my nurse first, huh?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: B-Both of your injuries...! Come on, just come with me, quickly—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wait, what are you all—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Maria, you look after the wounded. Don't need to worry about anything else.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Kowal!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Here's your bow, you old bones!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Looks like they brought company.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...They didn't come with.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Pfah. Who're we dealing with? Who sics themselves on competition knights in broad daylight?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That kid's an Infected. Let's go see what's what. Might need more than just Maria for this.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: —Marcin?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...On my way.
